description.purpose: GH #623: the smallest colony that answers a turn -- a door that echoes what it was told and stamps the route the answer travels on, and a sink that ends the lane.
description.use_when: As the end-to-end fixture for `meclaw ask`: one POST, one answer hop on the record, no provider and no wall clock.
description.not_in_scope: No llm cell, no tool loop, no channel state.
examples: meclaw ask --api 127.0.0.1:PORT --target /door 'hello' prints 'echo: hello' and exits 0
the same call with a text starting in 'fail' answers on route 'error' and exits 1
a turn sent straight to /sink is never answered, so the call runs into its --timeout and exits 2
